title: tecoma chrysea
intro: Tecoma chrysea, commonly known as the Yellow Bells, is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, providing various health benefits such as protecting against cell damage and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma chrysea include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, antimicrobial, and antifungal agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids.
